# Synthetic Integrity browser package

`source.zip` and its acquisition sidecar are generated by the shipped Java extractor from
`product/tools/integrity-extractor/fixtures`. They contain two synthetic Problem Reports,
repository-authored text evidence and a one-pixel raster; no live server/customer data, Java classes
or SDK jars are included. The manifest declares `evidenceMode: fixture` and `fixture-no-server`.
Ordinary hosts refuse this package; only disposable hosts explicitly allow fixtures.

The browser owner tests package review, image rendering, source date/outcome disclosure and mapping
invalidation through the real API. It does not submit an import. The existing Infrastructure
`The_real_extractor_preserves_scoped_bytes_and_typed_source_facts_and_is_not_live_evidence` test
continues to build the actual extractor, and compares the generated manifest and all ZIP member bytes
against this package. Packaging/checkpoint qualification remains owned below the browser layer.

To regenerate, use an owned new output directory and verified pinned dependencies:

```powershell
$env:JAVA_HOME = '<Microsoft OpenJDK 17.0.20.1+1 root>'
$env:AEROLINK_DEPENDENCY_CACHE = '<owned checksum-verified dependency cache>'
./product/tools/integrity-extractor/Build-Fixture.ps1 -OutputDirectory '<new owned output>'
```

Generation used Microsoft OpenJDK `17.0.20.1+1` (Microsoft-14940689), Gson `2.13.2` and
PTC SDK `4.16.2671`, with the dependency SHA-256 pins in `Build-Extractor.ps1`. Generate twice
into distinct directories, compare the manifest and every member byte, then copy the generated
`source.zip` and `source.zip.manifest.sha256` here together. ZIP container bytes can vary with Java
compression implementations; the manifest and member bytes are the format contract.

Recorded manifest SHA-256: `64029f56ee4863c08594e8303b8a4d8e2890d425749bf093fc33affc60afd015`.
Generated ZIP SHA-256: `96b35ebdcdc2ddeacd175878f91766f907babf9b5bea44adef57592bca631d5d`.
Two independent generation directories produced identical ZIPs and sidecars with this JDK.
